title: Pride Of The Empire
caption: •Pride Of The Empire (V)
game_text: If you just deployed a TIE/SA, deploy on a unique (•) TIE/SA. Bombing Run is {control}. May place this card in Used Pile to ▲ (or, once per game, retrieve) Bombing Run or ComScan Detection; opponent loses 1 Force. {control}
lore: Imperial starships that perform with distinction are highly publicized in an attempt to make the pilots look like heroes to the citizens of the Empire.

notes: Group: Everything else (sheet page 'Virtual Set 16: Everything else', DARK SIDE). Banner IMMEDIATE EFFECT, no grabber box → grabber false. Inline red circle-slash C after 'Bombing Run is' and at the end → {control} (stub 'Immune to Control'); ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. 'unique (•)' printed with the bullet. Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Dennis Hes' (left) / 'PC Volunteer Award 2007' (right) → credit_bottom. UNIQUENESS: the printed Decipher face (350 px decipher-archive scan, square-on 350×490, used as art.src) prints the title WITHOUT a uniqueness dot; the slip heading and caption print '•Pride Of The Empire (V)' and the stub says Unique → title kept without dot (printed card), caption with dot (as vs10/vs11 precedent). The wiki default page is the Glossary Supplement errata; the printed face is 'Pride Of The Empire (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px SE-D-prideoftheempire.gif is the D-E1 errata face (adds the dot; same art) — downloaded to src/vs16/61-SE-D-prideoftheempire.gif for art only. Lore matches the scans. Copyright: SE line, 1998 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: V11-D-prideoftheempire.gif (745, the Virtual Set 11 card — different text, same art/lore); VB2 -pre (338) also exists, not downloaded.
